name: Omni Rancho Las Palmas Resort
insider_take: This desert oasis sits in the heart of the Coachella Valley, where Hollywood legends once escaped to play golf under endless blue skies.
whats_special: The resort features the only resort water park in the Coachella Valley with a 100-foot water slide, lazy river, and sand beach area. Its championship golf course was designed by Ted Robinson and hosts PGA Tour qualifying events. The property sits on 240 acres of lush desert landscape with the Santa Rosa Mountains as a dramatic backdrop.
pro_tip: Book spa treatments during sunset hours - the Desert Willow Spa's outdoor relaxation areas offer stunning views of the mountains bathed in golden desert light.
dont_miss: The legendary El Paseo shopping district is just minutes away - known as the "Rodeo Drive of the Desert." Visit during the cooler evening hours when the palm-lined streets come alive with outdoor dining and the desert air carries the scent of blooming desert flowers.
pros: Championship golf course and tennis facilities on-site
Multiple pools including water slide and lazy river
Family-friendly resort with kids' club and activities
Prime Coachella Valley location with mountain views
cons: Large resort property requiring walks to amenities
Peak season pricing during desert high season
